meta.name: paid-advertising
meta.description: Plans, runs, and optimizes paid acquisition across search, social, and display — account structure, targeting, creative, bidding, budget, and the analysis that says whether to scale or stop. Use this to set up or restructure campaigns, write and iterate ad creative, diagnose rising costs or falling performance, decide budget allocation, or judge whether a channel is working.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划投放搜索、社交、展示广告,诊断成本上涨并优化预算分配。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在运营广告账户,想知道哪些钱该加、哪些该停。
copy.tagline_en: Launch and refine paid ad campaigns across channels, and know when to scale or stop.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage paid acquisition and need to scale winners and cut losers.

howto.what: Claude 会计划、运营并优化搜索、社交与展示类付费广告,产出账户结构、定向、创意、出价及预算方案,并按数据分析是加投还是停投。
howto.when: 当你说要处理付费广告相关任务,例如搭建或调整广告活动、撰写或改进广告文案、诊断成本或效果问题等时触发。

say.text: 帮我把搜索广告按品牌、问题词、品类拆成不同广告组
say.note: Claude 会按意图层级设计广告结构。

say.text: 最近广告成本一直涨,转化却没变,帮我找原因
say.note: Claude 会先看展示、点击、转化等环节再下结论。

say.text: 这个社交渠道投了两周没转化,该停吗?
say.note: Claude 会检查数据是否足够,避免过早下结论。

howto.what_en: Claude plans, runs, and optimizes paid acquisition across search, social, and display—producing account structure, targeting, creative, bidding, and budget plans, and analyzing data to decide whether to scale or stop.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for help with paid-advertising tasks, such as setting up or restructuring campaigns, writing ad creative, or diagnosing cost or performance issues.

say_en.text: Split my search ads into groups by brand, problem, and category intent.
say_en.note: Claude will structure by intent tier.

say_en.text: My ad costs are rising but conversions are flat—diagnose why.
say_en.note: Claude inspects impressions, CTR, and conversion in order.

say_en.text: This social channel has no conversions after two weeks—should I stop?
say_en.note: Claude checks for significance before deciding.
